format: YAML Object Repository + YAML Reusable Components + YAML Test Cases + YAML Test Lab

scaffolder.runtime: native shell (bash 3.2+ / PowerShell 5.1+), no Node required

sampleFiles.description: YAML page object: page, scope (PROJECT|SHARED), elements keyed by friendly name with one locator (role|testId|label|placeholder|text|css|xpath).
YAML reusable component (schemaVersion, testCase, scenario, steps[]).
Reusable flow built from object-level steps (Fill/Click/assert).
YAML test case (schemaVersion, testCase, scenario, tags[], steps[]) orchestrating reusables via Execute -> Scenario:Reusable.
YAML execution set (schemaVersion, name, release, executions[] with execute/testScenario/testCase/iteration/browser/platform).
Global data sheet keyed by GlobalDataID; referenced as #VariableID.
Named data sheet keyed by Scenario,Flow,Iteration,SubIteration; referenced as Sheet:Column.

items.description: Environment / URL selection reusables (SelectEnv, SelectEnvWithCluster, SelectToken, SelectURL).
Generic database connection reusable (initDBConnection -> executeSelectQuery -> storeDBValueinDataSheet -> closeDBConnection).

generatedFiles.format: JSON schema version 3.1.0. Built by scanning TestPlan/*.yaml (testcase) and ReusableComponents/*.yaml (reusable); _meta holds the base scenario attribute plus discovered scenarios and tags; data holds id (Scenario#Name), name, tags and type/scenario attributes.
